english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken way to tell someone information.
Use this casual construction when you mean telling a particular person some information directly.

examples.english: I’ll inform you that you don’t have to come to work tomorrow.
examples.traditional: 我話畀你知，聽日唔使返工。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 waa6 bei2 nei5 zi1 ting1 jat6 m4 sai2 faan1 gung1

examples.english: I communicate to Ming that I will not go to work tomorrow.
examples.traditional: 我話畀阿明知我聽日唔返工。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 waa6 bei2 aa3 ming4 zi1 ngo5 ting1 jat6 m4 faan1 gung1
